input.summary: Collect high Flash Bank values, backhand two unqualified locks, then start Three-Ball Multiball and score the bank, spinner, and lock passage with 3x playfield scoring.

quickInfo.name: Flash Bank
quickInfo.summary: The first target stops a moving value, and a timed four-bank completion collects it.

quickInfo.name: Three-Ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Lock two balls without qualification, then hit the release target or lock a third ball to begin 3x playfield scoring.

quickInfo.name: Two-Ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Lock one ball and hit the release target to begin 2x playfield scoring.

quickInfo.name: Magna-Save
quickInfo.summary: A separate cabinet button spends stored magnet time to push a ball away from an outlane.

steps.text: Plunge medium-soft. Deflect the upper-right feed to the upper-left flipper and cradle when this copy permits it.
Wait for an 80,000 or 100,000 Flash Bank value. Hit one target to stop it, then complete all four targets before timeout.
modeNotes: Flash Bank: The first target stops the moving value and starts its timer; bank completion collects the value, while a sweep scores it twice.

steps.text: Repeat the Flash Bank while the ball stays on the upper playfield. A Cave shot can raise the stopped value but uses the same timer.
On the lower playfield, cradle on the left flipper and backhand the Ball Lock. No qualification is necessary.
modeNotes: Ball Lock: The horseshoe passage stores up to two balls before multiball; physical locks are shared between players.

steps.text: Lock a second ball. Ignore the ready release target until two balls are stored.
Hit the upper release target or lock the third ball to start Three-Ball Multiball.
modeNotes: Three-Ball Multiball: 3x playfield scoring lasts while three balls remain, then becomes 2x playfield scoring with two balls and normal scoring with one.

steps.text: During multiball, stop Flash Bank at 100,000 and complete it for 300,000; a sweep scores 600,000.
If the spinner is lit, backhand it from a controlled right-flipper hold for 6,000 per spin while three balls remain.
Repeat the Ball Lock passage for 90,000 while three balls remain, then return to the upper Flash Bank when one ball remains.

fallback.title: Upper Flash Bank
fallback.when: Use this when the Ball Lock rejects or another player can steal the physical locks.

steps.text: Keep the ball on the upper playfield.
Start Flash Bank at 80,000 or 100,000.
Complete the bank before timeout.
Ignore the Cave detour unless the Flash Bank timer is generous.
Complete L-I-Z-A-R-D when safe to light the spinner and raise Bonus X.

alternatives.title: Two-Ball Multiball
alternatives.when: Use this when one physical lock is safe but the second is not.

steps.text: Backhand one ball into the Ball Lock.
Shoot the upper release target to start Two-Ball Multiball.
Collect Flash Bank with 2x playfield scoring.
Shoot the Ball Lock passage for repeat 60,000 awards.

alternatives.title: A/B and bonus
alternatives.when: Use this when both ramps are reliable and upper drops reject.

steps.text: Complete A and B once, then use the right passage for Bonus Holdover.
Complete A and B again to light the outlanes.
Complete L-I-Z-A-R-D for Bonus X and a lit spinner.
Protect the multiplied bonus and held base bonus.

buildsToward.title: Three-Ball Multiball at a high Flash Bank value

steps.text: Score Flash Bank values on the upper playfield.
Lock two balls during controlled lower-playfield visits.
Start Three-Ball Multiball with the release target or third lock.
Stop Flash Bank at 100,000 and complete it for 300,000.
Sweep the bank for 600,000 while three balls remain.
Use the lit spinner and Ball Lock with 3x playfield scoring.

playfieldReferences.label: Flash Bank
playfieldReferences.description: Four upper drops used to stop and collect the moving timed value.

playfieldReferences.label: Cave
playfieldReferences.description: Upper-left loop that can raise a stopped Flash Bank value.

playfieldReferences.label: Ball Lock passage
playfieldReferences.description: Lower-left horseshoe passage that stores up to two shared physical locks.

playfieldReferences.label: Multiball release target
playfieldReferences.description: Upper-right standup used to release stored balls and start Multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Center spinner
playfieldReferences.description: Spinner between the upper flippers worth 2,000 per spin when L-I-Z-A-R-D is complete.

playfieldReferences.label: L-I-Z-A-R-D targets
playfieldReferences.description: Six standups used for Magna-Save time, lit spinner, and end-of-ball Bonus X.

techniques.name: Upper-playfield skill shot
techniques.instruction: Plunge medium-soft, deflect the upper-right feed left, cradle, and start Flash Bank at 80,000 or 100,000.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Backhand the Ball Lock from the lower-left flipper and the lit spinner from the lower-right flipper.

techniques.name: Short Magna-Save pulse
techniques.instruction: Press the Magna-Save button briefly to reverse an outlane-bound ball instead of holding the magnet.

cautions.issue: A spinner exit can hit the frame and drain through the center.
cautions.response: Keep both lower flippers ready after each spinner shot.

cautions.issue: A Ball Lock eject can return through the center.
cautions.response: Do not release a cradle until you see the eject path.

cautions.issue: Magna-Save can send the ball in an unpredictable direction.
cautions.response: Use a short press only when an outlane drain is likely.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm L-4 and Adjustments 31–44 for timers, feature memory, Extra Ball, Special, lock, and difficulty behavior.
Physical locks are shared; check stored balls before every turn and expect another player to release or steal them.
Test Flash Bank timing, both locks, release target, spinner, Cave, four flippers, and both Magna-Saves before choosing a route.
input.simpleOverview: In Grand Lizard, completing the timed upper Flash Bank awards its displayed value, and two lower locks start three-ball Multiball with 3x playfield scoring. Collect a high bank value, backhand both locks, then release the balls. Rebuild Flash Bank at 100,000 and sweep it while three balls remain.
